name: @chariot/load-test
description: Tests de charge Artillery pour les microservices Chariot

scripts.load:smoke:report: mkdir -p reports && artillery run chariot-all-services.yml --environment smoke --output reports/smoke.json
scripts.load:dev:report: mkdir -p reports && artillery run chariot-all-services.yml --environment dev --output reports/dev.json
scripts.load:stress:report: mkdir -p reports && artillery run chariot-all-services.yml --environment stress --output reports/stress.json
